---
name: project-validation
description: Review 3DEngelen project content and image references without changing files.
---

Read the requested `projects/<slug>/project.md` and `pictures/` folder, then run `npm run check` and `npm run build`. Report each problem with its exact file path, field or line, and suggested fix. Verify the title, one-to-ten-sentence description, hero reference, descriptive alt text for every picture, optional `YYYY-MM` completion, printers, materials, flat tags, featured flag, labeled resource URLs, and optional SEO/gallery references. Check supported image formats, ensure alt text is independent of optional captions, verify image ordering and source-photo suitability, and confirm prose claims are supported by the supplied material. Confirm the project represents completed work, not a draft or progress update, and check for accidental personal data. Do not modify any file unless explicitly asked; distinguish confirmed errors from editorial suggestions.
